name: Riverside Village
author: voodoo573
description: A small farming village split by a river. A dirt road crosses a wooden bridge and passes a cobbled square with a well. Seven cottages, a crop field, scattered trees and crates fill the rest of the map. 30 x 22 squares at 64 px per 5-ft square.
summary: Small village with river, bridge, well square and cottages.
credits: Original battle map created for the Hearth Community repository by voodoo573 (2026), drawn procedurally with a Python/PIL script; no third-party art used. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
